title: Conjugation of a character
statement: Let $G$ be a finite additive commutative group, let $\chi:G\to\mathbb C$ be an additive character, and let $x\in G$. The conjugate character evaluated at $x$ is the complex conjugate of $\chi(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\chi$ is an additive character from $G$ to $\mathbb C$
